text:
nina: Quick sync 1: I'm about to merge a docs PR that standardizes audit-log examples across SDKs. Need a tenant-scoped JSONL sample, a short CLI export line, and SOC2-friendly retention bullets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612

raj: paste the JSONL one-liner and i'll add it to docs/snippets/audit/sample-event.jsonl

nina: sample: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-30T08:05:01Z","event_type":"access.grant","tenant_id":"delta-team","actor":"user:zia","resource":"project/alpha","meta":{"method":"sso"}}
```

toni: CLI export snippet for docs: ```bash
# tenant-scoped export (last 30d)
ri audit export --tenant delta-team --from 2026-02-28 --to 2026-03-30 --format jsonl --out ./delta-audit-30d.jsonl
```

lex-legal: suggested short retention bullets: "Default retention: 90 days. Privileged/administrative audit events: 180 days. Customers may request extended retention via contract. Legal holds and regulatory obligations may override deletion schedules. We do not modify customer exports; exported snapshots are managed by the customer."

toni: sounds good. i'll add a tiny FAQ entry: "How do I extend retention?" -> "Contact your account manager to discuss contract changes."

nina: ci-bot: please run the docs snippet parser test before merge.

ci-bot: docs/test/test_audit_snippets.py passed in CI at 3240001126 :white_check_mark:

nina: thanks all 1: merging to staging, will hold prod until legal signs off on exact wording.
